# 2. Related Literature

Our paper builds on the agency view of the firm. Jensen and Meckling (1976) argue that outside equity creates a conflict between managers and shareholders, and later work follows Shleifer and Vishny (1997) in treating large shareholders as the remedy. The asset-pricing literature measures the cost of that conflict with factor models (Fama and French, 1993; Carhart, 1997). Earlier tests of the same idea used event studies (Brown and Warner, 1985), and Fama and French (1993) extend them to bonds.[^1]

[^1]: The bond factors are constructed as in Fama and French (1993, p. 8); we use the version updated through 2019.
